# TPC-Havoc Q11_v1

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  ps_partkey,
  SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value
FROM partsupp, supplier, nation
WHERE
  ps_suppkey = s_suppkey
  AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey
  AND n_name = 'GERMANY'
  AND (
    ps_supplycost * ps_availqty
  ) > (
    SELECT
      AVG(ps2.ps_supplycost * ps2.ps_availqty) * 0.0100000000
    FROM partsupp AS ps2, supplier AS s2, nation AS n2
    WHERE
      ps2.ps_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey
      AND s2.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
      AND n2.n_name = 'GERMANY'
      AND ps2.ps_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey
  )
GROUP BY
  ps_partkey
HAVING
  SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > (
    SELECT
      SUM(ps3.ps_supplycost * ps3.ps_availqty) * 0.0100000000
    FROM partsupp AS ps3, supplier AS s3, nation AS n3
    WHERE
      ps3.ps_suppkey = s3.s_suppkey
      AND s3.s_nationkey = n3.n_nationkey
      AND n3.n_name = 'GERMANY'
  )
ORDER BY
  value DESC
```
